about.text: The Russian soured milk. Traditionally milk was left to sour on its own or started with some ready soured milk. Factory versions use pure cultures that define the type: mesophilic lactococci for ordinary prostokvasha, thermophilic streptococci with Lactobacillus bulgaricus for the Mechnikov kind.

how.text: Prostokvasha is simply soured milk, today made with pure cultures of lactococci or thermophilic streptococci; variants add the Bulgarian bacillus (Mechnikov) or L. acidophilus.
